failed: Sign-in did not work. Try again.
setupText: Scan the code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows. Your role needs this for every sign-in.
verifyText: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
setupStep1: Install an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
setupStep2: In the app, add an account and scan this QR code. If you cannot scan it, enter the key below.
setupStep3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows to confirm.
signInText: We e-mail you a sign-in link, or you can use your Google account. Then you enter your two-step code.
checkText: If {email} has an ANANDA account, a sign-in link is on its way. It works once, for 15 minutes.
resent: Sent again. Use the newest e-mail.
linkExpiredTitle: This link doesn't work any more
linkExpiredText: Sign-in links work once, for 15 minutes. Ask for a new one.

errors.no_account: No ANANDA account uses that Google account. Sign in with the e-mail address you were invited with, or ask an admin to invite you.
errors.google_failed: Google sign-in did not work. Try again, or use a sign-in link.
errors.google_off: Google sign-in isn't switched on yet. Use a sign-in link.

inviteText: Accept the invitation for {email} to sign in. Next you set up two-step sign-in.
inviteLater: After this, you sign in with a link we e-mail you, or with Google.
